description: This source file implements a minimal API endpoint within an ASP.NET Core application to list catalog items in a paged manner. It defines the CatalogItemListPagedEndpoint class with methods to add routing and handle HTTP GET requests for catalog item listings, including filtering and pagination logic.

classes.name: CatalogItemListPagedEndpoint
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint for retrieving paged catalog items, including route configuration and request handling with filtering, pagination, and response composition.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Adds a GET route to the app with specified URL and binding to handler method.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the incoming request to fetch filtered and paged catalog items, constructs the response, and formats picture URIs.
